name: Envy And Jealousy
overview: Scripture reveals that envy and jealousy are deeply destructive emotions that corrupt the heart and bring spiritual decay, as Proverbs describes envy as 'the rottenness of the bones' and warns of its overwhelming power. The commandment against coveting in Exodus underscores God's prohibition of desiring what belongs to another, highlighting the sinfulness of envy. While hatred leads to strife, love is presented as the covering of sins, pointing believers toward a heart transformed by God's ways. Ecclesiastes further reflects on the futility and vexation caused when one's labor provokes envy, emphasizing the emptiness that envy brings to both the envier and the envied.
